verdict.rationale: Omnara lets you add MCP servers to an agent config and discovers their tools, and the docs name Linear as an example, so agents could manage Linear tickets. Other trackers would depend on generic MCP or custom tools, since there is no first-party issue-tracker integration. Missing for 10: named or documented support for Jira, ClickUp, or Monday.com; native issue-tracker connectors; documented ticket-management workflows; hands-on corroboration.
